bundle._comment: Path to the ClaudeDesign bundle. The JSX file is the parse source.

tokens._comment_css: Path to colors_and_type.css if present in the bundle.
tokens._comment_swift: Path to a .xcassets directory with *.colorset/Contents.json. Set to null if not using Swift tokens.

figma._comment: Figma file key (from URL /design/:fileKey/...) and the staging page node id (format `123:4`).
figma._comment_canonical: Optional: the canonical page where promoted frames live. Currently informational only.

_usage.step_1: Copy this file to `cdf.config.json` (which is gitignored).
_usage.step_2: Fill in the absolute paths for your bundle and the Figma file key + staging page id.
_usage.step_3: Open Claude Code in this repo and run `/cdf-clone`, `/cdf-screen <Name>`, or `/cdf-review`.
